name: r6-killfeed
description: A sleek, interactive web application built to generate custom Rainbow Six Siege kill feed graphics. Perfect for content creators, thumbnail designers, and tournament organizers who need high-quality, transparent kill feed overlays.

paragraphs: A sleek, interactive web application built to generate custom Rainbow Six Siege kill feed graphics. Perfect for content creators, thumbnail designers, and tournament organizers who need high-quality, transparent kill feed overlays.
features: Live Tactical Preview: Instantly see your kill feed changes in a modern, R6-inspired UI.
Searchable Operator Roster: Quickly find the exact Killer or Victim using the built-in modal grid with custom operator icons.
Dynamic Loadouts: Weapon options automatically update based on the selected Killer.
Headshot Toggle: Easily add or remove the iconic R6 headshot indicator.
Custom Team Colors: Choose from authentic HUD colors (Blue, Orange, Red, Cyan, Yellow, Green, Purple) to match your scenario.
